params.label: Lens Guard Margin
params.description: A lens guard is supposed to block out direct rays from light sources outside the view angle. In screen space, this means that lights outside the view area should not cause lens effects. In reality lens guards, aren't perfect and when a light is nearly within view it will cause lens effects. The Guard Margin defines a rectangle around the view plane with width equal to margin. The flare intensity falls off in a linear manner within this region.

params.label: Focus Pull
params.description: By animating this parameter, the flares can be animated. The individual components will rotate and translate, to simulate a realignment of the camera optics. This parameter can also be used to select a certain configuration in the flare pattern.

params.label: Safe Overlay
params.description: When it is enabled, flares will take the underlying colour into account and try to make certain that the result does not exceed the maximum color intensity. If the flares rendered do not exceed this intensity, and the underlying scene neither, the result is guaranteed not to exceed.

params.label: Render Flare Only
params.description: When it is enabled, only the flare fx is output on black background. This is useful for compositing.

params.label: Brightness
params.description: This parameter controls the overall brightness of the flares. The brightness and visibility of the light also affect the flare brightness.

params.label: Size

params.label: Aspect Ratio
params.description: This parameter controls the aspect ratio of the individual flare elements.

params.label: Glow
params.description: This enables a glow around the light. This glow is simulated to occur at the light location, not at the camera location. This means that closer objects will obscure the glow, instead of the glow being added to them The glow size (in SI units) is settable. The brightness controls the overall brightness of the glow. The brightness of the light also affect the glow brightness. The falloff parameter value controls how sharp or soft the edge of the glow is.
